label: The reduced nominal description…, from Nothing has actuality except insofar as it… and 4 more
meaning: Version (b) of the discharge (owner decision on #143, 2026-10-24): a defense of the reduced nominal description, kept side by side with version (a) under its own statement ID. The conditions the reduced description drops follow from the ones it keeps: a being that is the only maximum in being and causes the being of all others also causes every perfection of the others and is part of nothing. So, given the fuller definition, the reduced description already suffices, and STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-UNIQUE-MAXIME-ENS is derived rather than assumed. It rests on the same open premises as version (a).
